_description: Cursor bundle MCP profile catalog. MCP is opt-in only — no profile carries default authority; a profile takes effect ONLY when a user explicitly selects it (`mewkit init --target cursor --mcp-profiles <name>` / `--mcp-profiles all`, or the equivalent interactive prompt). Applying a profile MERGES into `.cursor/mcp.json` — user server keys always win, conflicts are reported and never overwritten, and nothing is ever removed. Every string value below resolves through Cursor's documented interpolation vars only (`${env:NAME}`, `${workspaceFolder}`, `${workspaceFolderBasename}`, `${userHome}`, `${pathSeparator}`) — no literal secret value is ever stored in this file; the secret-emission lint in cursor-mcp-profiles.ts enforces this at apply time.

github-context.description: Read access to GitHub issues, PRs, and repo content via the official GitHub MCP server (stdio, npx-launched). Requires a GitHub personal access token to already be exported in the calling environment as GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN — this profile never stores the token value itself, only a reference to the env var name.
